title: I’m making a browser zombie shooter with suspiciously peaceful scenery
author: Reasonable-Dark1992
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve been working on Hollow County, a free zombie shooter you can play in your browser, and wanted to share a few clips. 

I designed an entire weather simulator, tree engine, wildlife, and physics. Solo play is free no account, multiplayer is free with account.

You fight through waves of zombies, build up a base, customize your guns, and rescue survivors along the way. There’s also a lot of peaceful countryside between the chaos. The deer are having a much better time than you are.

You can try it here: [playhollowcounty.com](https://playhollowcounty.com/)

I’d love some honest feedback, especially on how the shooting feels and whether the world makes you want to explore. Rip me a new one if you want! :)
